title: ClientCallPayload

callId.description: A client-addressed call's id: a UUID the run's environment mints, which the answer names.

clientSessionId.description: The client session the call is for: the one that started the run, or, for a run the environment started itself, the one that started the session's latest run a client started.

kind.description: A verb on a Chrome paired with the client's local environment.

pageKey.description: A session's page: the run environment's id and the session id, which the browser reads as an opaque name; one tab or browser context per key.

url.description: Where to open the page; absent, the session's page as it is.

snapshot.description: Answer with a snapshot of the page after the action, read as these arguments say; none when absent.

filter.description: interactive (preset): the elements that can be acted on and their context; all: every element.

depth.description: How many levels of the tree to read.

ref.description: Read only the subtree of the element with this ref.

maxChars.description: The most characters to answer, cut at the last line boundary within them, or mid-line when no line ends within them; preset 30000, at most 200000.

args.description: open: the session's page, made when it has none, at an address or as it is.

url.description: An address to open: an http or https URL, or a bare host with an optional port and path.

environmentId.description: The environment the Chrome is paired with, which the client reaches through its local connection.

anyOf.description: A paired Chrome's id: a UUID its environment mints when it pairs.

chromeId.description: The Chrome to drive; null for the plain My Chrome of that environment, the one paired Chrome connected there.

deadline.description: When the run stops waiting for the answer, on the run environment's clock: the verb's deadline after the call was made. A later answer is dropped.

payload.description: A verb for one session's page on a Chrome paired with another environment: the Chrome's environment and id, the page key, the verb and its arguments, a one-time allowance when a person allowed a denylisted address, and the deadline.
